author: Nelev
body:
## Summary

- **Removed** from `assistant_general_prompt.py`: the "Adding a document to the record" and "Fetching the record" sections, meaning the tool signatures, arguments and result statuses. The tools' own names, docstrings and schemas already give the model these.
- **Kept**, as one new section, **When to search**:
  - the search-when and don't-search-when lists
  - the red-flag rule: answer first, then search
  - "when unsure, search"
  - four tips on searching well: search for the clinical content, search once per part of the question, nearest is not relevant, and when to stop rephrasing
- **Added** one bullet to the don't-search list: "is about someone else".
- **Also dropped**: the "never state what the tool didn't return" paragraph. "What you never do" still forbids inventing or citing a `chunk_id` the tool didn't return. Net change: +13 / −60 lines.

## How it was checked

I ran the real agent (`gpt-4o-mini`, both tools, pgvector index, seeded patient) with the prompt from `main` and with this one, on 10 cases, 3 runs each. The upload case attached D12 (motor insurance renewal), which the check rejects, so nothing was written to the record.

| Case | `main` prompt | This prompt |
|---|---|---|
| History, drug, allergy, not in record, red flag | searched 3/3 | searched 3/3 |
| New symptom after a new injection | 2 searches each run | 2 searches each run (symptom + medication) |
| Attached PDF | `add_patient_document` 3/3 | `add_patient_document` 3/3 |
| Social, off-topic | no tools 3/3 | no tools 3/3 |
| Third party ("my wife gets migraines…") | no tools 3/3 | no tools 3/3 |

There were no errors and every reply was valid JSON.

With both sections removed outright (no search guidance at all), the model still picked the right tools. The third-party case regressed, though: it searched this patient's record for "migraines" in 2 of 3 runs. The new bullet is what fixes that.

## Test plan

- [x] `uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pytest -q` (165 passed)
- [x] Old-vs-new prompt comparison above (60 agent runs)
- [ ] Optional before merging: `uv run python -m dataset.eval.run_eval` for scored results on all 32 questions (billable)
- [ ] Not covered: the reply wording for a document that is *stored*, since the only upload tested is rejected
